items.reason: The migration dereferences an absent first category result and crashes before reaching the uncategorized fallback.
Legacy hosts are migrated without stripping schemes and paths, so they fail the new bare-host lookup.
Saved hosts retain accepted ports, but lookup uses URI.host without the port, preventing those records from matching.
The lookup lowercases only the stored hostname, causing mixed-case incoming hostnames to fail matching.
An empty category query result is dereferenced before the uncategorized fallback can run, aborting the migration.
Missing or unmatched embed_category settings produce an empty result whose first row is dereferenced, crashing the migration.
The normalization callback calls sub! on a nil host, raising before validation can return a normal error.
Validation and normalization preserve host ports, while lookup discards them through URI.host, so configured port-qualified hosts never match.
The unchanged incoming URI hostname is compared against lower(host), making matching incorrectly depend on URL capitalization.
The migration copies legacy full URLs verbatim, bypassing normalization and breaking the new bare-host authorization lookup.
Migrated entries retain schemes and paths because raw SQL bypasses model normalization, so previously allowed hosts no longer match.
The blank-host test lacks the other true-branch prerequisites and therefore passes without exercising host presence, providing misleading coverage.
